tip.moveearth_addtional.combat_logout.bo: Logging out during the combat timer leaves your body on the battlefield where it can be attacked or downed.
tip.moveearth_addtional.prisoners.title: Prisoners and Escorting
tip.moveearth_addtional.prisoners.body: Restrain downed enemies during a Siege, escort them, and use a prison intake inside valid territory.
tip.moveearth_addtional.rest_healing.bod: Beds and normal campfires restore health from a shared allowance that refreshes periodically.
